The bird has a compact, rounded body with orange-rufous breast and underparts, transitioning to white on the lower belly. The head is brownish-grey with darker mottling, indicating a female or non-breeding male. The bill is short, conical, and pale grey with a dark tip. Dark, round eyes are visible laterally. The wings are folded against the body, showing brownish tones with lighter edges. Pinkish-brown legs and feet are visible gripping the snow-covered ground. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green/brown.
